\land\mathsf{UCert}_{pCIC}(\mathcal K)\ne\varnothing
\land\mathcal P:\{(k,j):k<|\bar C|,\ j<|\operatorname{tel}_{pCIC}(\bar C_k)|\}

\land\forall k<|\bar C|\ \forall j<|\operatorname{tel}_{pCIC}(\bar C_k)|\
\mathcal P(k,j)\in\mathsf{PosTree}_{pCIC}(I,\pi_1(\operatorname{tel}_{pCIC}(\bar C_k)_j),+)

\operatorname{Positive}_{pCIC}(I)
\Longleftrightarrow
I\in\operatorname{dom}(\mathcal I)\land
\exists\ell,s,\bar p,\bar A,\bar\iota,\bar c,\bar C,\mathcal E,\kappa\
[\mathcal I(I)=(\ell,s,\bar p,\bar A,\bar\iota,\bar c,\bar C,\mathcal E,\kappa)

\mathsf{PosTree}_{pCIC}(I,\pi_1(\operatorname{tel}_{pCIC}(\bar C_k)_j),+)\ne\varnothing].

\mathsf{TreeCode}_{pCIC}
=\{(V,r,\operatorname{ch}):V\subseteq_{\mathrm{fin}}\mathbb N,\ V\ne\varnothing,\ r\in V,\
\operatorname{ch}:V\to V^{<\omega},\
\forall v\in V\ \operatorname{NoDup}(\operatorname{ch}(v)),\
r\notin\bigcup_{v\in V}\operatorname{ran}(\operatorname{ch}(v)),\
\forall u\in V\setminus\{r\}\ \exists! (v,j)\
(v\in V\land j<|\operatorname{ch}(v)|\land\operatorname{ch}(v)_j=u),\
\operatorname{Reach}(r)=V,\
\neg\exists n>0,\langle v_t\rangle_{t\le n}\ 
(v_0=v_n\land\forall t<n\ v_{t+1}\in\operatorname{ran}(\operatorname{ch}(v_t)))\}.
